1. Case overview

Summary. 13 plans were evaluated: 10 DMAT variants and 3 reference plans.

Clinical background and rationale. Lung SBRT prescribed 50 Gy in five fractions, with coplanar and noncoplanar planning groups. The comparison examines body, mediastinal-node and thoracic-marrow low-dose volumes across geometries.

Plan generation. DMAT plan generated for: Accela. Coplanar: 10FFF; 1 arc; modulation 0, +1, +2, +3; NonCoplanar: 10FFF; 2 arcs; modulation −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Reference setup: VMAT-Coplanar1 — 6 MV, 2 arcs; VMAT-Coplanar2 — 6 MV, 2 arcs; VMAT-NonCoplanar — 6 MV, 2 arcs.

Goal setup. The DMAT source reports contained 34–35 provided goals per plan, with priority identifiers, goal thresholds and acceptable-variation fields. Derived and automatic objectives were listed separately. For DMAT 0, examples were PTV V50.00 Gy ≥ 95.0 % (P1.9); Lungs-ITV V20.00 Gy ≤ 8.0 % (P1.1).

Comparison methods. Dose colorwash, DVHs, individual endpoint–time plots and the saved 27-endpoint scorecard were compared. All saved dose factors were 1.0; no additional rescaling was applied. Scores summarize the selected endpoints. DMAT timing came from matched metrics; reference timing used an RT Plan control-point estimate.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice. Slice positions are synchronized across plans.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

Dose viewer loads when visible.
5 GyRx 50 Gy59.5 Gy

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on VMAT-Coplanar1’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. The compact zoom buttons, pointer drag, and reset remain synchronized and persist while changing slices. Mouse-wheel scrolling continues to move the report page. All plans use the confirmed 5–59.5 Gy color scale.
